newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Hewlett-Packard buys Siltek assets.
newsitem.headline: Hewlett-Packard buys Siltek assets.

text.p: South African information technology group Siltek Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to sell certain businesses and related assets of its HiPerformance Systems unit to Hewlett-Packard Co.
The two companies said they expected the purchase price, payable in cash on November 1, to be based on the tangible net asset value of the businesses as at October 31, plus a payment for goodwill.

"The proceeds of the disposal, including HiPerformance surplus cash retained by Siltek and commission on future sales, cannot be precisely quantified at this stage but is estimated to be of the order of 200 million rand," the companies said in a statement.
Siltek said it would explore investing the proceeds of the sale to form business partnership with Hewlett-Packard and other information technology concerns.
